svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Have a machine shop make it: 84 x 40 x 20 mm stainless block

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a threaded spigot underneath that fits the canner's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: own vent-pipe hole (10 mm here: measure the canner) and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nut and high-temperature gasket to clamp it to the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 6 mm up through the spigot to the gland port on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two side ports on top, 30 mm each side of the centre: the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: canner's own vent pipe (its thread) and 1/4 in NPT for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: transducer; drill a 4 mm passage from the bore to each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gland port 1/8 in NPT on the centre for the probe gland.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The lid itself is not drilled; the overpressure plug stays.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the probe in, a 3 mm drill passes the vent

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: passage, and a 2.5 mm wire passes beside the probe.
